_comment: Control for [FILM-AUDIO], measured on REAL material from projects/tokyodrift2006 - the shipped final.mp4, its own no_vocals stem, its own narration and bed. The first set of bars came from a synthetic control (pink noise as the stem, a 330 Hz tone as the music) which gave a 45x separation and did not survive contact with the film: on the real render it produced 0.048 on / 0.029 off, a 1.65x separation with six false findings.

same_span_both_ways._comment: The decisive control: the SAME source span mixed with and without the stem at -17 dB, under the same narration and the same bed. Only the stem differs. 8s windows.

rows.note: the stem is silent here (-51 dB): nothing to detect either way
the stem is silent here (-76 dB)

alignment_defect._comment: The check sampled the finished file at the NARRATION start but the stem at the CLIP start - an offset of the lead-in (0.5s, 1.1s on a reveal), far beyond the +-50ms lag search. These are the same windows measured both ways on the shipped file.

rows.note: reported as a leak at 0.033; it was the misalignment, not a leak

whole_draft_corrected._comment: All 102 narrated lines of the shipped render, clip-aligned and clip-bounded, at the -45 dB informative floor. The medians separate cleanly; the per-line tails OVERLAP, which is why the verdict is on the distributions and no per-line finding is emitted.

rejected_explanations.slowed_clips: atempo on a slowed clip would decorrelate it, but only 1 of 102 lines is slowed - not the cause
rejected_explanations.crossfade_bleed: the off-lines flagged in the shipped report (6, 7, 13, 14, 15) sit around the on-run 8-11, which looked like adjacency bleed; with correct alignment they fall to 0.018-0.026 and no leak remains
rejected_explanations.stem_missing_from_action_clips: the shipped report said 5 of 8 action/tense windows carried no film audio; corrected, the action/tense median is 0.1056 against 0.0327 elsewhere
